_comment: Saved to ~/realtor-brain/editor/config.json by studio-setup. ONE config for every engine: the brand block is shared so Riverside and Instagram Edits look identical. Only the chosen engine's block is required.
_default_engine_comment: Which editor owns a plain 'edit my video': 'riverside' (edits in the agent's Riverside account, any Claude surface) or 'edits' (Instagram Edits for Mac, driven from the Code tab of the Claude desktop app on the agent's Mac, free; the optional second engine — 'riverside' is the main path). Saying the engine's name in a request always wins. 'descript' is retired.

riverside.note: Connected in Claude → Settings → Connectors → Riverside. No API key is stored here.

edits.note: Instagram Edits for Mac + the insta-edits bridge (pip3 install --user insta-edits; token via `/usr/bin/python3 -m insta_edits set-token`; `claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio edits -- /usr/bin/python3 -m insta_edits serve`). Mac only, from the Code tab of the Claude desktop app or the terminal; the optional second engine.
edits._pexels_comment: Optional, free: lets the B-roll craft download bright stock clips into footage_dir. Edits' own stock panel is not reachable from the server.

_brand_source_comment: FALLBACK POINTER ONLY — where the brand block below gets refreshed FROM. Skills read the 'brand' block below at edit time (resolution order #1).
_brand_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the editor's brand (both engines). Setup writes the captured colours/font here. If blank, readers fall back to the Brain's identity/brand-visual.md, then tasteful defaults. There is NO separate brand.json file.

sfx.note: Optional. Riverside has no built-in SFX library reachable from the connector. If the agent drops a licensed swoosh (MP3/WAV) into Your Media, record its media id here and the energy pass uses it.

_caption_style_comment: On Edits, `edits.caption_style` (a catalog style name) wins over this Riverside look name.

riverside_stock.note: Built in (Pexels via Riverside). No key needed.

_publish_route_comment: ONE posting route per post. 'riverside' = Riverside's connected accounts (studio-publish). 'shortform-tool' = the Short-Form System's Metricool/GoHighLevel/Buffer. 'manual' = the agent shares from Edits' share sheet. Values: riverside | shortform-tool | manual. Long-form YouTube can use 'riverside' while reels use the short-form tool; never both for the same post.

preferences._comment: Learned from revisions (Review and Revise, Audio Enhance). Each new video starts here.
